verdict.label: PASS
verdict.conclusion: Estimator choice materially changes coherence diagnostics, capital ranking, or de-risking triggers; ewma has the largest observed subadditivity failure rate.

limitations: Daily ETF close-to-close returns only; no intraday liquidity or execution model.
Cornish-Fisher ES is numerically approximated from the CF-transformed normal tail.
Subadditivity is tested on equal-weight two-asset portfolios, not every possible weight vector.
yfinance vendor snapshots can drift; CSV snapshots are stored for this run.
